title: multi record writes failed agents' zero figures into the run rows and deltas and records no failure count
goal: multi record counts each failed agent (budget, error, timeout) in a failures metric and leaves its zero tokens, cost and wall time out of the run's totals and the deltas (review of SP-5y4ut64g).

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
def clean(*dirs):
    import bench_multi
    for d in dirs:
        shutil.rmtree(bench_multi.clone_path(d, 1).parent, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
import csv
d = os.path.join(T, "cap"); o = os.path.join(T, "rows.csv")
try:
    bench("multi", "run", "lookups", "--replay", "--max-usd", "0.0001", "--dir", d)
    r = bench("multi", "record", "--dir", d, "--out", o)
    assert r.returncode == 0, (r.returncode, r.stderr[-400:])
    m = {x["metric"] for x in csv.DictReader(open(o, encoding="utf-8"))}
    assert any("fail" in k for k in m), ("no failure metric in", sorted(m)[:20])
finally:
    clean(d)
